{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Also compute the number of patients with multiple rows (re-tested)
df_counts = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
n_retested = (df_counts > 1).sum()

# Print only the numbers that will be in the evidence
print(n_patients)
print(n_retested)"}
